A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the MDGs are not only a challenge for recipient countries, but also for donors.
the MDGs have been a major driver of aid allocation, but the sectoral results reveal that donors have not done their best to allocate aid in a way to maximise the impact of aid on achieving the MDGs.

aid allocation needs to be improved in order to achieve the MDG targets.
donors need to do a better job in aligning aid with recipient country needs.
donors have to be held accountable for the sectoral allocation of aid and for their efforts to target aid towards those sectors and countries where it is most effective in achieving the MDGs.
